senses.gloss: सुख- + अर्ह सुख- + अर्ह, adj. deserving pleasure, Rām. 3, 52, 41.
सुख- + आरोहण सुख- + आरोहण, adj. of easy ascent, MBh. 2, 1281.
सुख- + आलोक सुख- + आलोक, adj., f. का, charming, Vikr. d. 109.
सुख- + आशय सुख- + आशय, adj. hoping for pleasure, Pañc. ii. d. 160.
सुख- + उदर्क सुख- + उदर्क, adj. causing happiness, Man. 9, 25.
सु- + खादि सु- + खादि, adj. beautifully adorned, Chr. 293, 6 = Rigv. i. 87, 6.
सु- + ख्याति सु- + ख्याति, f. fame.
सुखपुण्याह- + घोष सुखपुण्याह- + घोष, i. e. सुख-पुण्य-अह-, m. the proclamation of a happy holiday.
सुख- + राज सुख- + राज, m. a proper name, Rājat. 5, 206.
सुख- + लेश सुख- + लेश, m. insignificant pleasure, Bhāg. P. 6, 9, 38; Pañc. i. d. 203.

सुख् सुख्, i. 10, सुखय (rather a denomin. derived from the next), Par. To make happy, to comfort, Megh. 86; to delight, Vikr. d. 61; MBh. 3, 181; Hit. i. d. 96, M.M. सुखित (ptcple. pf. pass., or सुख + इत), Pleased, Vikr. 59, 1; happy, Śāk. d. 99. n. Happiness, Mālav. 33, 3.

सुख सु-ख,
 I. adj.
 1. Happy.
 2. Joyful, Ṛt. 6, 2.
 3. Agreeable, sweet, Chr. 16, 15; Rām. 3, 55, 45.
 4. Virtuous, pious.
 5. Easy, Pañc. 211, 10.
 II. खम्, adv.
 1. And सुखेन, Joyfully, Nal. 17, 18; Pañc. 53, 7; iii. d. 79; well, Pañc. iii. d. 164; Vikr. 65, 17 (सुखम् आस्तां भवान्, Farewell).
 2. Placidly, Man. 1, 54.
 3. Willingly, Bhartṛ. 2, 49; Indr. 4, 18; with following न पुनर्, Rather...than, Bhartṛ. 2, 100 (तेजस्विनः सुखम् असून् अपि संत्यजन्ति...न पुनः प्रतिज्ञाम्, The virtuous renounce even life rather than break a promise).
 4. And सुखेन, Easily, Bhartṛ. 2, 3; Pañc. 52, 20; 48, 2.
 III. n.
 1. Happiness, Pañc. 184, 2.
 2. Joy, MBh. 12, 12427.
 3. Pleasure, Vikr. d. 49; Pañc. 216, 10; alleviation, Pañc. iv. d. 19.
 4. Easiness, see
 II.
 4. 5. Paradise.
 6. Water.
 --Comp.

सुखद सुख-द,
 I. adj. Affording pleasure, Pañc. ii. d. 2.
 II. f. दा, A courtesan of Indra's heaven.
 III. n. The seat of Viṣṇu.
सुखमय सुख + मय, adj., f. यी, Full, or consisting of happiness.
सुखस्थ सुख-स्थ (vb. स्था), adj. Happy, Pañc. i. d. 406.

सुखिन् सुखिन्, i. e. सुख + इन्,
 I. adj., f. नी.
 1. Happy, Pañc. 262, 10.
 2. Glad, Hit. 78, 3.
 3. Pleasant.
 4. Comfortable (corpulent), Hit. 106, 16.
 II. m. A religious ascetic.
सुखोद्य सुखोद्य, i. e. सुख-उद्य (ptcple. of the fut. pass. of वद्), adj. To be uttered agreeably, Man. 2, 33.
सुखारोहण- + सोपान सुखारोहण- + सोपान, i. e. सुख-आरोहण-, adj. having stairs easy ascent, MBh. 2, 1281.
